name: Semantic / synthesis failures
one_line_definition: Agent work may occur but the final answer fails to deliver required information in the requested form

name: Decomposition / corrupt-success failures
one_line_definition: Required subtasks are dropped or only partially completed while the final answer frames total success

name: Error & exception handling
one_line_definition: Agent mishandles a tool error or missing-resource result in interpretation or final answer; the environmental cause itself is Axis B

name: Feasibility & gracefulness
one_line_definition: Agent behavior around impossible or blocked tasks is judged by honesty timing and recovery quality

name: Process quality
one_line_definition: Outcome correctness is separated from whether the trajectory is valid safe and non-wasteful
